column1: # Tier detection (D64, D114): the key quests that show a progression stage is reached. Read by
# gregtec.ingest.quests.read_tier_keys. The detected stage is the highest one with a complete key
# quest (any of its rows); "stone" has none, so a new world starts there. Stages and GT voltage
# tiers: stone 0, steam 0, LV 1, MV 2 ... UMV 12, UXV 13.
# Quest ids are BetterQuesting's compact ids (q:<id>); the names are for review only. Ids, names
# and the tasks quoted in the notes are from GTNH 2.9.0's DefaultQuests (pack_version 2188), (c)
# the GT: New Horizons team, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; facts only, read 2026-11-06.
# From MV up, each key quest is the tier chapter's own "Tier N (X)" quest, which asks for that
# tier's machine hull (gregtech:gt.blockmachines, meta = GT's mID).
